name: Rohit Dash

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rohit Dash, also published as Rohit Kumar Dash, is a poet and fiction writer associated with Bargarh, Odisha. His writing includes Odia, English and Sambalpuri. His English poetry collections include The Poesy Wings and The Mystery of Missing, published by Notion Press.

His Kabita Live poems give a direct voice to inward pain and resistance to imposed identities. “Suffering” follows a sleepless speaker through attempts to find peace. “THE ENQUIRY” answers questions about caste, creed, surname and nationality with an insistence on a wider human belonging. Its movement from the womb and tomb to the cosmos enlarges the space in which the speaker asks to live freely.
